name: AlphaTON Capital Corp. Common Stock
summary: Alpha Compute Corp. (Nasdaq: ALP) is a high-performance GPU infrastructure and confidential-compute technology company built for the artificial intelligence economy. Structured as a holding company focused on sovereign AI compute, Alpha Compute owns the infrastructure that powers modern intelligence and enforces privacy directly at the hardware level. That foundation positions the company to build and acquire businesses that depend on confidential compute and artificial intelligence. Alpha Compute's mission is to support clients, subsidiaries, and partners across critical sectors such as finance, defense, intelligence, and media as they adapt to a rapidly changing AI landscape. The company provides the core framework any organization needs to run secure, confidential computing environments. Alpha Compute is domiciled in the British Virgin Islands, with offices in New York, Los Angeles, Miami, Amsterdam, and Toronto.
